workspace.agentSwitchHelp: Changing CLI or model starts a fresh agent session. It may lose tool context and cache reuse, making the next reply slower or less consistent. Your conversation and files are kept. Any running turn continues with its original agent.

workspace.availableToolsHelp: Open a tool to explore setup options
workspace.benchmarkCommunityHelp: Test any supported model with your installed agent or API connection. Local and imported runs appear in Community & local. Official results are maintained by Simjecture.
workspace.benchmarkIntro: Measured scientific coding tasks. Compare completion, time and API-equivalent cost.

workspace.collectionHelp: Conversations can have their own questions. Existing study records stay unchanged.

workspace.continuationHelp: Talk through the next step in chat; your agent then drafts its brief.

workspace.fileEmpty: Files you upload and files your agent creates appear here.

workspace.grillHelp: Your agent interviews you one question at a time, pushes back on vague points, then writes the study brief.
workspace.hostedToolsIntro: Verified tools provided for this hosted workspace.
workspace.installedToolsGuide: The agent can use all available installed tools and choose which ones each experiment needs.
workspace.installedToolsHelp: Installed tools and detected local builds
workspace.interactiveBest: getting started, debugging, and working out what to ask.

workspace.machineConnectHelp: Connect with an SSH address and your SSH key, agent, or password. We’ll detect the hardware and prepare the worker.
workspace.machineCooperativeHelp: Restricted containers use a dedicated unprivileged worker with cooperative execution.
